mechanism: Leflunomide is hepatically metabolized and may inhibit CYP450 enzymes; piperacillin-tazobactam undergoes renal elimination and both drugs can affect hepatic and renal function, potentially increasing mutual toxicity in patients with organ impairment.
action: Monitor renal and hepatic function periodically; assess for signs of leflunomide toxicity; ensure adequate renal function for piperacillin-tazobactam clearance; consider dose adjustment if significant organ dysfunction develops.
